+def quat_slerp(a, b, t):
+    a = np.asarray(a, dtype=np.float64); b = np.asarray(b, dtype=np.float64)
+    a /= np.linalg.norm(a); b /= np.linalg.norm(b)
+    dot = float(np.dot(a, b))
+    if dot < 0:
+        b = -b; dot = -dot
+    dot = np.clip(dot, -1.0, 1.0)
+    if dot > 0.9995:
+        q = a + t * (b - a)
+        return (q / np.linalg.norm(q)).tolist()
+    theta = np.arccos(dot)
+    return (np.sin((1-t)*theta)/np.sin(theta)*a + np.sin(t*theta)/np.sin(theta)*b).tolist()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Recorded RoboLab controller for larger_object_raisin_box_in_bin."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = Path("/app/output")
RUNS = OUT / "runs"
RUNS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def save_obs(obs, name):
    d = RUNS / name
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (d / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
    for cam, img in obs.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(img).save(d / f"{cam}.jpg", quality=92)
    for cam, data in obs.video.items():
        (d / f"{cam}.mp4").write_bytes(data)

def move(robot, pose, name):
    result = robot.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(pose, dtype=np.float32), video="mp4", note=name)
    save_obs(result, name)
    print(name, json.dumps({k: result.meta.get(k) for k in ("done", "reason", "plan", "clipped", "control_steps_chunk", "time_left_s")}), flush=True)
    return result

def quat_slerp(a, b, t):
    a = np.asarray(a, dtype=np.float64); b = np.asarray(b, dtype=np.float64)
    a /= np.linalg.norm(a); b /= np.linalg.norm(b)
    dot = float(np.dot(a, b))
    if dot < 0:
        b = -b; dot = -dot
    dot = np.clip(dot, -1.0, 1.0)
    if dot > 0.9995:
        q = a + t * (b - a)
        return (q / np.linalg.norm(q)).tolist()
    theta = np.arccos(dot)
    return (np.sin((1-t)*theta)/np.sin(theta)*a + np.sin(t*theta)/np.sin(theta)*b).tolist()

def main():
    robot = Robot()
    print("connected; initial", json.dumps(robot.get_obs(video="none").meta.get("proprio")), flush=True)
    # Reset orientation points the fingertip tool down. Move laterally in free space,
    # keeping the jaws open, to a hover above the raisin box.
    q = [-2.98e-7, -0.70710683, 0.70710695, 1.788e-7]
    q_turn = [0.0, -1.0, 0.0, 0.0]  # 90 degree world yaw, with the approach still down
    phase = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "hover"
    if phase == "hover":
        move(robot, [[0.3595, 0.2045, 0.31, *q, 0.0]], "hover_raisin")
    elif phase == "descent":
        move(robot, [[0.3590, 0.2000, 0.085, *q, 0.0]], "descend_raisin")
    elif phase == "grasp":
        move(robot, [[0.3590, 0.2000, 0.085, *q, 1.0]], "close_raisin")
    elif phase == "lift":
        move(robot, [[0.3590, 0.2000, 0.19, *q, 1.0]], "lift_raisin")
    elif phase == "lower":
        move(robot, [[0.3590, 0.2000, 0.19, *q, 0.0],
                     [0.3590, 0.2000, 0.022, *q, 0.0]], "lower_retry_raisin")
    elif phase == "close_retry":
        move(robot, [[0.3590, 0.2000, 0.022, *q, 1.0]], "close_retry_raisin")
    elif phase == "reorient":
        move(robot, [[0.3590, 0.2000, 0.022, *q, 0.0],
                     [0.3590, 0.2000, 0.20, *q, 0.0],
                     [0.3590, 0.2000, 0.20, *q_turn, 0.0]], "reorient_above_raisin")
    elif phase == "yawrotate":
        obs0 = robot.get_obs(video="none")
        p = obs0.meta["proprio"]["now"]
        q0 = p[11:15]
        poses = [[p[8], p[9], p[10], *quat_slerp(q0, q_turn, t), 0.0]
                 for t in (0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.0)]
        move(robot, poses, "yawrotate_raisin_grasp")
    elif phase == "lower_rotated":
